limitations: All counts use metadata/identity evidence, not end-to-end Folia runtime verification.
Family counterpart counts include partial coverage, related releases, grids and in some cases processed subsets; read each CSV row before treating any source as equivalent.

Registry total includes related MERRA2 aggregation, PRISM resolution, Wyvern processing level, EOG derived data, GEBCO edition and Meta canopy version; direct/component subtotal is reported separately.
External/native and Source Coop figures are lower bounds from this documented search, not exhaustive absence claims. Unmatched does not mean GEE-only or needs conversion.
Source Coop counts exclude the Maxar metadata-only mirror. Chesapeake training chips and generic building Parquet products do not establish an accepted native format.
ESA InputQuality needs viewer/Terrascope access; COG format is not a promise of anonymous access or unrestricted licensing.
Direct Source Coop README requests returned 403 in this environment. Evidence comes from accessible publisher web pages and retained local crawl metadata, not successful object reads.
ETH canopy direct request returned 403 and is left unresolved despite the community page advertising COGs.
No GEE jobs, bulk data downloads, full asset inventories, or runtime builds/tests were performed.
